cleanup.limits: Resource refusal preserved; no business TPS acceptance or retry. Original final2 owned scans show launcher only despite budget failure.

capacity.limits: Final original central-directory sizes, not timestamp-of-refusal component allocation. Only recovered bodies separately CRC/size/SHA-verified; not whole-ZIP digest or allocated-block accounting. LevelDB .log and consensus WAL are data, not direct process stdout logs.

validInclusionBlocks.interpretation: Only complete consecutive interior blocks within the offer window contribute. Interior TPS is withheld if observed block coverage has a gap or incomplete block, avoiding selection of successful intervals. This finite observation is not sustained/steady-state qualification.

limits: Resource interruption censors submission and confirmation tails; diagnostic prefix only, not sustained TPS or qualified case.
Selected original ZIP members verified by206 range/CRC/size/SHA; no whole-ZIP digest.
Public bytes/hash and original proof flags checked offline; no independent cryptographic/consensus re-verification.
Nested/parallel/cumulative stages cannot be added into finality. Final size breakdown is not allocation at instant of refusal.
Data64 is a separate unexecuted capacity proposal, not a throughput optimization.
